question: In a circle, chord AB subtends 60° at the center. The angle between the tangents at A and B is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **angle between the tangents** drawn from an external point and the **angle subtended by the chord** at the center are **supplementary** (sum to 180°).

⇒ Angle between tangents + Angle at center = 180°

⇒ Angle between tangents + 60° = 180°

⇒ Angle between tangents = 180° − 60° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Angle subtended by chord **AB** at the center (O) = ∠AOB = 60°.

⇒ Tangents are drawn at points **A** and **B**, meeting at an external point **P**.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ The radius is **perpendicular** to the tangent at the point of contact (∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°).

⇒ Sum of internal angles of a **quadrilateral** = 360°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b6de82c8daa7024a5d87c9476a15cb6ee53c60632791d463d5b91a0f414650.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In quadrilateral **OAPB**:

⇒ ∠OAP = 90° (Radius ⊥ Tangent)

⇒ ∠OBP = 90° (Radius ⊥ Tangent)

⇒ ∠AOB = 60° (Given)

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OAP + ∠APB + ∠OBP = 360°

⇒ 60° + 90° + ∠APB + 90° = 360°

⇒ 240° + ∠APB = 360°

⇒ ∠APB = 360° − 240° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent-Radius Property

The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

Length of Tangents

The lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are always equal (PA = PB).

Angle Bisector Property

The line joining the external point to the center of the circle bisects the angle between the two tangents (∠APO = ∠BPO).

Cyclic Nature

Quadrilateral OAPB is always cyclic because the sum of opposite angles (∠OAP + ∠OBP = 180°) is constant.</p
